'''Endorian mosquitoes''' were large flying, parasitic [[Insect/Legends|insects]] found in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Mosquito/Legends|mosquitoes]] had [[Color/Legends|green]] bodies with orange eyes, and a large stinger. They emitted a high-pitched buzzing noise.
